statement: Laboratory is a World 4 passive skill with very little active gameplay; split into two sections plus a weekly-resetting small shop.
Bring character to the Laboratory and click Upload Player in the Mainframe to activate it; red X disappears.
Once a character is active in Lab it can't be used for anything else until extracted; extracted characters lose Lab bonuses.
Before leveling up you need at least two uploaded characters in the Lab to gain any benefits.
Drag first character near the prism to create a line then drag next character near the bonus you want; connect the dots.
Goal is to connect more bonuses with the fewest characters so other characters can do other things.
One square box gives Total Damage for every pet breed unlocked.
Another box makes uploaded players print 2 times more on the 3D Printer.
Sigils from Alchemy need the Lab bonus activated to unlock.
Jewels are a second type of Mainframe bonus; multiple of each color and each gives a bonus.
One jewel gives 40% more Lab Experience.
One jewel makes Construction Slot 1 three times faster.
One jewel increases the bonus from the Animal Farm and gives more damage.
Console Tab holds Lab rewards unlocked by leveling characters; each benchmark unlocks a new Chip Slot with passive bonuses.
Chips are single use and can be equipped on one character at a time unless you have multiple copies.
There are 22 chips available and currently 7 chip slots can be unlocked; bonuses include damage defense skill efficiency.
Chips can be removed by deselecting and re-added to another character so don't be afraid to equip them even if not long-term.
The weekly-resetting Lab shop is unlocked by buying specific items from the World 4 NPC shop.
Buy 3 Pile of Processor Chips (one per day) then click and hold to unlock the Chip Repository shop.
Buy 7 Strung Jewels from the NPC shop to unlock the Jewel Spinner shop.
The shops are located between the Mainframe and the Lab Tubes and are somewhat hidden.
Chip Repository lets you buy 2 chips each week; they differ and reset weekly with a timer; they cost lots of resources.
Chip costs include materials skilling or monster drops plus cooking meals and spices from Breeding foraging; they are worth unlocking.
Boosts mainframe line width chip is a very good chip to get.
Jewel Spinner is one of two ways to unlock jewels; requires rare drops plus lots of meals and spices.
Pick up the weekly shop items quickly since they reset each week to reduce time unlocking all jewels.
Gem Shop World 4 bonuses sells Mainframe Jewels at 450 gems each limited to 2 per week; 18 jewels total so it takes many weeks.
Lab Efficiency only increases EXP gain and gives no other skill benefit.
Don't waste time getting too much efficiency if you can't hit breakpoints; at 12.1K he gains almost nothing extra.
No class can specialize in any World 4 skill so use whichever characters aren't used for other things.
Each Lab level increases Pixel Width allowing fewer characters to gain the same bonuses.
Lab Ring and Laboratory Scrubs directly increase Lab Efficiency.
Lab Ring upgrade: Souped Lab Ring Recipe can drop from new mini-boss Mutated Mush.
Upgrade shoes at the Anvil Tab 4 into Sheek Scrubs using 4 Laboratory Scrubs for 400 Lab Efficiency if you can afford the materials.
Corn is the earliest recipe giving much Skill Efficiency.
Garlicless Bread gives a direct bonus to Lab EXP.
Pancakes is the earliest recipe increasing Line Width in the Lab Mainframe.
Each Pancakes level gives 2 more pixels from all characters.
Multiple recipes provide these bonuses and stack; about two offer Pixel Width so more cooking gives extra Pixel Width.
Card priority starts from World 4 mobs.
Gelatinous Cuboid card gives more Lab EXP gain.
Crystal Custard card gives more passive line width.
Chaotic Troll card gives 30% more efficiency to all skills.
Chaotic Efaunt card gives more skill EXP gain.
Bunny card and Amarok card both give more skill AFK gain rate.
Use the Easy Resources card set for the biggest benefit to skill efficiency.
Science Spare Parts Box gives up to 1600 Lab Efficiency and 29% Lab EXP; +18 base LUK likely placeholder.
Lab Tube Stamp at bottom of Skills tab gives 10% more Lab EXP at level 10.
Lab Tube Stamp is a great way to raise Line Width faster by gaining more experience.
